subcategory_text: Apply secure-build tooling (compiler flags, linkers, packaging) and protect the build infrastructure against tampering.
implementation_examples: L1: Apply compiler hardening flags and standard tooling
L2: Sign and verify build artefacts; reproducible builds
L3: Hardware-rooted build integrity (e.g., HSM signing)
assessment_objectives: Determine whether the build is hardened.
Determine whether build artefacts are integrity-protected.
